facts.fact: Xinhua reports that Cote d'Ivoire's digital transition ministry signed three memoranda with the private sector on 19 May 2025 to speed implementation of the existing National AI Strategy (SNIA).

systems.owner: Ministere de la Transition numerique et de la Digitalisation

note: The memoranda are not stated to carry public money; the ministry is not named as the strategy's executing body.
